title: Google Gemini 4 Argon Surges Open AI, May Directly Replace Programmers in Submitting Code

content_html:
Recently, the overseas tech circle has been abuzz with a major announcement: Google's next-generation powerful AI model, Gemini 4 Argon, has been appearing intensively on multiple platforms and is now being made available to some Pro users. The model has been fully integrated into the Google Cloud ecosystem, not only set as the default model in the new programming tool Antigravity, but also beginning to submit code directly to real code repositories.

Embodied Intelligent Agents Revolutionize Development Paradigms

Differing from traditional AI tools that only provide code completion, Gemini 4 Argon demonstrates strong characteristics of advanced intelligent agents, capable of participating in deep programming like an independent employee. In addition, Google has also prepared the Concierge service, which supports real-time voice, aiming to create a comprehensive AI assistant that connects workflows.

Hard-Hitting Capabilities Challenge Complex R&D Challenges

Currently, thousands of Google employees are deeply testing this model in core areas such as professional coding, large-scale codebase migration, and quantum computing. It can easily handle large-scale legacy code refactoring across languages and has shown terrifying reasoning capabilities in assisting quantum computing research, indicating Google's comprehensive counterattack in the AI field.
